standard: Manager can demonstrate knowledge of critical controls; required records available; open corrective actions understood.
Illness reporting followed; restricted/excluded employees handled correctly; wounds protected.
Hair/beard restraint, clean clothing, correct glove use, no unsafe personal practices.
Sinks stocked/accessibly; employees wash correctly and at required times.
Temperatures, package condition, frozen condition, substitutions/shortages, rejection decisions controlled.
TCS cold foods maintained at 41°F or below; equipment functioning; temps recorded.
Hot foods maintained at 135°F or above; equipment functioning; temps recorded.
Required internal temperatures achieved; thermometer used correctly.
Cooling method, pan depth, airflow, time/temperature checks and records acceptable.
Muriale’s tape system used consistently; product rotated; expired/unlabeled food corrected.
Raw/RTE separation; clean tools; safe storage order; hand/glove changes.
Ticket communication, clean tools/surfaces, ingredient verification, cross-contact controls.
Food protected, food-grade containers, off floor, clean shelving, dry storage orderly.
Correct sequence; sanitizer concentration; test strips; food-contact surfaces; wiping cloths.
Dish machine/3-compartment sink effective; clean/dirty separation; air drying.
Labeled, stored away from food, no mixing, SDS/PPE/dilution controls.
Equipment clean/in repair; plumbing, drains, floors, walls, ceilings, lighting, ventilation acceptable.
No evidence; exterior doors/seals controlled; service documentation available.
Trash, dumpster, grease, drains and service areas controlled and clean enough.
Employees can explain the standards relevant to their jobs; retraining completed where needed.
